reasoning: 驗證目標：Page Up 請求時，整頁項目被移除，並由來自較高位置的新項目整批取代；以及清單頂端的 wrap-around。關鍵情境條件：目前顯示位置在清單中段（一般值）或已在清單頂端（邊界值）。為什麼這樣切：依 R10-2 吸收同節未配置的邊界條款 4872502（Page Up 於清單頂端 wrap-around 至底部）並多引，依 Profile §4 wrap-around 為邊界而非獨立功能，以 boundary 為軸拆兩條（§8.3）。刻意略過：分頁粒度由 043 覆蓋；Page Down 方向由 045 覆蓋；4872502 的 Radio:noSys scope 標記不一致同 041/042，送 RD-1。

tcs.tc_title: Page Up replaces all displayed items with higher positions
tcs.test_item: When a Page Up function is requested, the all items on the list shall be removed, and the new list items from the next-higher list positions shall replace all previously displayed list items
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. A Tuner Station List holding more items than fit on two pages is displayed
5. The displayed rows start at a position in the middle of the list
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read every displayed item
2. Read the block of list items held in the next-higher list positions, above the displayed page
3. Request the Page Up function once
4. Read every displayed item
tcs.expected_result:
1. A full page of list items is displayed
2. The block of items in the next-higher list positions is identified
3. The page request is accepted
4. The block read in step 2 fills the page and none of the items read in step 1 is displayed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Page Up at the top of the list wraps to the bottom
tcs.test_item:
If a Page Up is requested and the HU is currently at the top of the list, the HU shall wrap-around to the bottom of the list

(Top-of-list boundary)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. A Tuner Station List holding more items than fit on two pages is displayed
5. The first page of the list is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the displayed items and confirm the first list item is in the top-most position
2. Read the items held at the end of the list
3. Request the Page Up function once
4. Read every displayed item
tcs.expected_result:
1. The first page of the list is displayed
2. The items at the end of the list are identified
3. The page request is accepted
4. The items read in step 2 are displayed, which places the display at the bottom end of the list
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
